title: Sexual Fantasy
summary: Sexual fantasies are imagined scenarios that someone finds arousing. They are extremely common, and having a fantasy doesn't mean you want to act it out in real life.
key_points: Sharing fantasies with a partner is optional and works best with trust.
Acting on any fantasy needs everyone's consent.
